answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on verifiable delay functions interleaved with localized peer attestation quorums. Written in a practical systems telemetry descriptions, crisp technical observations register, it stays short. A sparrow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dawn of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The atlas of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
